# Volume 2 timeline

## CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — The narrator reflects on the mysterious nature of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) while the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean). During the journey, the crew observes various marine life, including shoals of argonauts and sharks, and witnesses the natural phenomenon of a 'milk sea' caused by bioluminescent organisms.

## CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and his companions to visit the pearl fisheries of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), mentioning the potential danger of sharks. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), feeling uneasy about the prospect of encountering sharks underwater, later explains the nature of pearl fishing to [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). Despite the risks, the group prepares for the upcoming excursion.

## CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md)** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to the pearl banks of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon). While observing a native diver, the group witnesses a shark attack; Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) engages the shark in a life-or-death struggle, and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) ultimately kills the beast with his harpoon. The group rescues the Indian diver and returns him to his boat before attempting to revive him.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) engages in a life-or-death struggle with a shark to save an Indian diver, but is nearly killed until [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) intervenes and kills the beast. After reviving the diver and gifting him a bag of pearls, the group returns to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). The event leaves Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) reflecting on Captain Nemo's hidden capacity for compassion toward the oppressed.

## CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels from the Laccadive Archipelago through the Sea of [Oman](../codex/places.md#oman) and into the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea). During the journey, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discuss their uncertain destination, while [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) later engages Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) in a detailed conversation about the history of the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal. The chapter concludes with Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) revealing that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) will reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) by traveling through a natural subterranean passage beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez).

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) discuss the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal and the achievements of M. Lesseps. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) will reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) by traveling through a secret, natural subterranean passage beneath the isthmus, which he calls the Arabian Tunnel.

## CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) hunt a giant dugong near the Arabian coast, eventually killing it after it attacks their boat. Later, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) navigates the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a secret tunnel beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez), successfully transitioning the vessel from the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean).

## CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After entering the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discusses escape plans with Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), though the professor remains hesitant. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) later uses a diver to transport a chest of gold to an unknown destination and subsequently guides the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a dangerous submarine volcanic eruption near [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin). The vessel eventually departs the area, leaving the professor to reflect on the perils of attempting an escape in such volatile waters.

## CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels at high speed through the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), preventing [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) from attempting an escape. During the journey, the narrator discusses geological history and the future of the earth with [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) while the vessel navigates past submarine barriers. [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) eventually exits the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

## CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) plans an escape attempt for that night, leaving Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) in a state of anxious indecision. However, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) stops in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay), where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) interrupts [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to recount the history of the sunken Spanish galleons. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then reveals that he has been harvesting the immense treasure from these wrecks to fund his operations.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) observes the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) salvaging gold and silver from the historic wreckage in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay). Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) explains that he uses these treasures to aid the oppressed and suffering, revealing that his wealth serves a humanitarian purpose rather than personal greed.

## CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After failing to escape the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) confirm their location in the middle of the ocean. Later, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) on a deep-sea excursion, where they walk along the ocean floor to discover the ruins of the lost continent of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis) illuminated by an underwater volcano.

## CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) enters an underwater cavern inside an extinct volcano, which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses as a secret base to mine coal and replenish his sodium reserves. Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) explore the interior of the volcanic crater, where they gather honey and hunt game. After the crew completes their work, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) departs the refuge to continue its voyage through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic).

## CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Sargasso Sea](../codex/places.md#sargasso-sea) and across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), during which the narrator reflects on their captivity and Captain Nemo's mysterious nature. Later, the submarine performs a deep-sea sounding operation, reaching extreme depths where Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses photography to capture the underwater landscape before rapidly ascending to the surface.

## CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss the crew size of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) with Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), reflecting Ned's growing restlessness. Later, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encounters a pod of whales and a group of attacking cachalots; Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) uses the vessel to slaughter the cachalots to protect the whales. The chapter concludes with the crew harvesting milk from a dead whale, while [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) notes Ned's intensifying resentment toward the Captain.

## CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) becomes trapped in an impassable field of ice while navigating the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic). Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his audacious plan to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) by traveling beneath the icebergs, and after preparing the vessel, he successfully maneuvers the submarine into the depths to continue their journey.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) prepares to navigate beneath a massive iceberg to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). After a tense journey submerged under the ice, during which the vessel repeatedly strikes the overhead ice ceiling, the submarine finally emerges into open water.

## CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md)** — Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) explore the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) coast, observing the local wildlife and volcanic terrain while searching for the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). [The Captain](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains anxious to observe the sun at noon to confirm their exact location before the onset of the six-month polar night. Despite their efforts, poor weather conditions repeatedly prevent the necessary astronomical observations, leaving the final confirmation for the following day.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) travel to a peak in the [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) to observe the sun at the equinox. Using a chronometer and instruments, they confirm their arrival at the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) at noon. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) then plants a black flag to claim the territory in his own name.

## CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is struck by an iceberg and becomes trapped in an icy tunnel. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) works to maneuver the vessel, but after several shocks and failed attempts to navigate the passage, he informs the narrator that all exits are blocked, leaving them trapped.

## CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Trapped under an iceberg, the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) faces the dual threats of suffocation and being crushed by freezing water. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads a grueling effort to dig a trench through the ice while using the ship's machinery to pump boiling water to prevent further solidification. Ultimately, the crew uses the weight of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to break through the final layer of ice, successfully freeing the vessel.

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus** — As the crew suffers from oxygen deprivation, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) executes a final, desperate maneuver to break the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through the remaining ice. The vessel successfully rams through the ice-field, allowing fresh air to flood the ship and saving the passengers from suffocation.

## CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Nautilus** — The narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) recover their strength on the platform of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) while discussing their desire to escape. As the submarine travels north along the coast of South [America](../codex/places.md#united-states), the narrator observes various marine life and geological features, while Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains unseen. The journey continues past the [Amazon](../codex/places.md#amazon) and the equator, marked by scientific observations and a dangerous encounter between [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and an electric ray.

## CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — While the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is stalled by giant cuttlefish entangled in its screw, the crew and passengers engage in a desperate hand-to-hand battle on the deck. During the violent struggle, one crew member is snatched away by a monster, and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) is nearly killed before being saved by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). The creatures are eventually driven off, leaving the crew exhausted and mourning their lost companion.

## CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — Following the death of a crew member, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) becomes withdrawn while the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream). [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), desperate to escape as they near North [America](../codex/places.md#united-states), urges Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to confront the Captain about their captivity. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) refuses to grant them freedom, and the chapter concludes with the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) braving a violent hurricane off the coast of [Long Island](../codex/places.md#long-island).

## CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), tracing the path of the transatlantic telegraph cable and eventually arriving near the coast of [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) guides the vessel to a specific location on the ocean floor to observe the wreckage of the French ship 'The Avenger'. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) recounts the ship's heroic final battle, revealing his somber connection to the site on the anniversary of its sinking.

## CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is pursued by an unidentified warship that begins firing upon them. Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), driven by a deep-seated hatred for the vessel's nation, refuses to let his companions signal for help and eventually rams and sinks the ship. After watching the vessel and its crew perish, [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) retreats to his quarters to mourn his own lost family.

## CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After weeks of isolation and growing horror toward Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), the narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) plan their escape from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). As they attempt to detach their small boat, they discover the submarine has been caught in the Maelstrom off the coast of [Norway](../codex/places.md#norway). The boat is violently torn away from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), leaving the narrator unconscious.

## Chapter 24

**[Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), France, Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), Norway** — The narrator, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) find themselves safe in a fisherman's hut on the Loffoden Isles after escaping the maelstrom. The narrator reflects on their incredible journey and wonders about the fate of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), hoping that the captain has found peace.
